children.doc: `stdio.semio.graph` text carrier: the envelope constants, the grammar vocabularies with their ordinals and the DSL reader and printer, written from the committed grammar alone.
`stdio.semio.graph` pack carrier: the LEB128 frame and the pack reader and writer, with every enum ordinal taken from the order the DSL grammar declares its alternatives in.
`stdio.semio.graph` mutation verbs: how each verb is applied to the parsed document and the undo steps it owes, read off the committed specification vectors.
